title: German cases at a glance
intro: Look at the verb or preposition to decide which case you need. Then choose the matching article.

title: Präsens – Perfekt – Futur I
intro: Everyday A1–A2 sentences. German often uses the present tense with a time expression to talk about the future.

title: Wo? / Wohin?
intro: With two-way prepositions, Wo? asks about a location (dative). Wohin? asks about a destination (accusative).
